critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~906 lines (was 660). Refactor into routers/{auth,patients,pregnancies,appointments,analytics,dhis2}.py before iteration 4 to keep maintainability.

_compute_dhis2_indicators date filter uses ISO-string comparison on the visit_date / death_date fields — works only because the codebase consistently stores YYYY-MM-DD strings. If any future code stores datetime objects in those fields, the lexical $gte/$lte will silently mis-aggregate. Recommend explicit type coercion or a Pydantic StringDate type to enforce.

DHIS2 export endpoint returns the payload with `value` as integer; DHIS2 DataValueSet spec expects all values as strings. Consider casting to str() for full spec compliance before posting to a real DHIS2 instance.
/audit-logs has no pagination cursor — only `limit` query param. For real Ministry-scale audit trails, add `offset` or createdAt-cursor pagination + index on created_at.

/analytics/dhis2-indicators accepts period without checking len/digit format (only uses if len==6) — invalid periods silently fall through to all-time aggregates. Apply the same 400 validation as /dhis2-export for consistency.
CORS still allow_origins=['*'] + allow_credentials=True (carried over from iteration 2). Browsers reject cookies in that combo; tighten before production.
